text: Hypothesis: reflections in context change later agent decisions for the better
description: Research cycle 2026-11-08 (Memory-Centric Continual Learning, arXiv 2610.29357: judge memory by whether it improves future actions). Measure three ways: (1) A/B replay from harness traces: rerun decompose/execute stages with and without the reflection section, compare decisions and verifier verdicts; (2) repeat-mistake rate: share of newly created ideas within high cosine of an earlier cancelled/failed idea, tracked over time; (3) citation log: does the model cite a reflection, and are outcomes better when it does. Pass if (1) shows better verdicts with reflections at matched cost. Refuted if no difference over ~30 replays.

status.comment: Proposed by Claude from the 2026-11-08 research cycle.
